title: Crispy Indian Pecan Vada
description: A unique twist on the traditional Indian vada, this recipe adds the crunch of pecans and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: indian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Soak the yellow split chickpeas in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then mash them in a bowl using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the crushed pecans, indian spices, and vada batter to the bowl. Mix well.
Add salt to taste and mix again.
Gradually add water to the bowl to achieve the right consistency for forming vadas.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the vada mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the vadas until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the vadas from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the crispy Indian pecan vadas hot with your favorite chutney or sauce.
